meta.title: Improve input tracking with debouncing
meta.body_summary: Add debouncing to input tracking actions (uiohook events, mouse moves, keyboard input) to produce smoother ComputerAction logs by coalescing rapid events into trace_mouse and type_keys actions.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added debouncing and input coalescing; PR closed by author after 7 days with no review or comment.
